turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Good choice. Remember: he/she/it + verb + -s (He drinks). After -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o we add -es (She goes).

Try this: She ___ (watch) TV after dinner. Write only the verb.
